name: @merl-ai/mcp-toolbox
stderr:
Usage: mcp-toolbox [options] [command]

Generate repo-committed code wrappers for MCP servers to enable token-efficient
tool use.

Options:
  -V, --version            output the version number
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]           Initialize mcp-toolbox in the current repo
  add [options]            Add an MCP server to mcp-toolbox.config.json
  remove [options] [name]  Remove an MCP server from mcp-toolbox.config.json
  introspect [options]     Connect to configured MCP servers and snapshot
                           tools/list
  sync [options]           Introspect servers, snapshot schemas, and regenerate
                           wrappers
  help [command]           display help for command
(outputHelp)
